lines.show: Hi! This is ScamKavach — a free scam checker for every Indian phone.
lines.say: Hi! This is Scam Kavach, a free scam checker for every Indian phone.

lines.show: In 2024, Indians lost ₹22,845 crore to cyber fraud — three times more than the year before.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-four, Indians lost twenty-two thousand, eight hundred and forty-five crore rupees to cyber fraud. That's three times more than the year before.

lines.show: Over 36 lakh fraud complaints were filed. And half of UPI fraud victims never even report it.
lines.say: Over thirty-six lakh fraud complaints were filed. And half of U P I fraud victims never even report it.

lines.show: ScamKavach is simple. Paste any suspicious SMS, WhatsApp message or link.
lines.say: Scam Kavach is simple. Paste any suspicious S M S, WhatsApp message, or link.

lines.show: In one tap, you see whether it's a scam — and exactly why.
lines.say: In one tap, you see whether it's a scam, and exactly why.

lines.show: Here it caught a fake SBI link pretending to be the bank, a threat to block the account, and panic words like “immediately”.
lines.say: Here, it caught a fake S B I link pretending to be the bank, a threat to block the account, and panic words like, immediately.

lines.show: Then it tells you what to do: don't click, don't pay, never share an OTP, and report the sender.
lines.say: Then it tells you what to do. Don't click, don't pay, never share an O T P, and report the sender.

lines.show: It's built for Bharat. The whole app works in Hindi and Marathi.
lines.say: It's built for Bharat. The whole app works in Hindi and Marathi.

lines.show: This is the UPI refund trick. Remember: you never need your UPI PIN to receive money.
lines.say: This is the U P I refund trick. Remember, you never need your U P I pin to receive money.

lines.show: Here's a fake “digital arrest” threat in Marathi.
lines.say: Here's a fake digital arrest threat, in Marathi.

lines.show: There is no such thing as a digital arrest — and ScamKavach says so, in the user's own language.
lines.say: There is no such thing as a digital arrest. And Scam Kavach says so, in the user's own language.

lines.show: It doesn't cry wolf. A genuine bank OTP message is recognised as normal.
lines.say: It doesn't cry wolf. A genuine bank O T P message is recognised as normal.

lines.show: 57 automated tests check both scams and real messages.
lines.say: Fifty-seven automated tests check both scams and real messages.

lines.show: Every scam result has a one-tap WhatsApp alert, so the warning spreads faster than the scam.
lines.say: Every scam result has a one-tap WhatsApp alert, so the warning spreads faster than the scam.

lines.show: Already lost money? Call 1930, the national cyber crime helpline, right from the app.
lines.say: Already lost money? Call one, nine, three, zero, the national cyber crime helpline, right from the app.

lines.show: Four golden rules stay on screen, to stop fraud before it starts.
lines.say: Four golden rules stay on screen, to stop fraud before it starts.

lines.show: And it's private. Your message never leaves your phone.
lines.say: And it's private. Your message never leaves your phone.

lines.show: No login, no server — and it works even on low-end phones.
lines.say: No login, no server, and it works even on low-end phones.
